dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Emma, is Canadian food similar to Thai food?
dialogue.reading: ˈɛmə, ɪz kəˈneɪdiən ˈfuːd ˈsɪmələr tə ˈtaɪ ˈfuːd?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: No, it's very different from Thai food. It isn't spicy!
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ɪts ˈvɛri ˈdɪfərənt frəm ˈtaɪ ˈfuːd. ɪt ˈɪzənt ˈspaɪsi!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: When you compare Thailand and Canada, what's the biggest difference?
dialogue.reading: wɛn juː kəmˈpɛr ˈtaɪlænd ənd ˈkænədə, ˈwʌts ðə ˈbɪɡɪst ˈdɪfrəns?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: The weather! Canada is very cold in winter.
dialogue.reading: ðə ˈwɛðər! ˈkænədə ɪz ˈvɛri ˈkoʊld ɪn ˈwɪntər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Is Canadian English the same as American English?
dialogue.reading: ɪz kəˈneɪdiən ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ðə ˈseɪm əz əˈmɛrɪkən ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: It's similar, but not the same. Canadians say sorry a lot!
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈsɪmələr, bʌt ˈnɑːt ðə ˈseɪm. kəˈneɪdiənz ˈseɪ ˈsɑːri ə ˈlɑːt!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Really? What do Thai people and Canadians have in common?
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? ˈwʌt duː ˈtaɪ ˈpiːpəl ənd kəˈneɪdiənz ˈhæv ɪn ˈkɑːmən?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: A lot! We love food, and we love our families.
dialogue.reading: ə ˈlɑːt! wiː ˈlʌv ˈfuːd, ənd wiː ˈlʌv aʊər ˈfæməliz.
